report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations: run1 to run3 measured, run4 and run5 marked "not run".
Only run1, run2 and run3 have result files. run4 and run5 did not finish.
I did not put Dana's estimates in the table as if they were measured. They sit below the table, labeled as estimates.
Both estimates look wrong on physics: run3 shows partial offload tripling TTFT, so "run4 10% below run2" on TTFT is unlikely; f16 is likely slower than q4_k_m, not 5% faster.
Open: run run4 and run5 before the review, or confirm that labeled estimates are acceptable.
